doc_kind: medical policy (UnitedHealthcare Commercial and Individual Exchange)
effective_or_revised: Policy number printed 2026T0616O (file/library number 2026T0616N); Effective Date September 10, 2026 on the PDF (library metadata says 2026-06-01)
sections_in_order: Medical Records Documentation Used for Reviews
criteria_location: Coverage Rationale, pp.1-2 (one short block): all-of criteria, contraindications, unproven list, and ESI limitations with subsequent-injection rules. Definitions p.2 carry the meaning of Radicular Back Pain and Conservative Therapy. Everything after p.4 is evidence review and references (about 10 pages), skippable.
procedures_covered: ESIs for other spinal indications as unproven

logic.top_level: all (four criteria) with a separate limits block for repeats

k_of_n.quote: unresponsive to the following conservative treatment for ≥ 4 weeks: Pharmacotherapy ...; or Activity modification ...; or Physical therapy or home exercise

logic.exclusions_or_contraindications: 'Conditions that would contraindicate ESIs include but are not limited to: Spinal neoplasm; Rapidly progressing neurological deficit; Epidural abscess' (open list) and a 'unproven' list: ultrasound guidance and 'ESIs for all other indications of the spine not included above'.
logic.initial_vs_repeat: Yes, under 'ESI limitations': max four sessions per region per year; subsequent ESIs only if radicular pain has returned/function deteriorated AND one of: previous injection <= 50% relief or functional improvement for less than 3 months with reassessment of individual, site and technique; OR >= 50% relief or functional improvement for 3 or more months.

and_or_ambiguity.quote: The previous injection resulted in ≤ 50% pain relief or functional improvement for less than 3 months ... or The previous injection resulted in ≥ 50% pain relief or functional improvement for 3 or more months
and_or_ambiguity.why_ambiguous: Both branches include exactly 50%, so 50% relief is in both; the first branch (poor response) still permits another injection after a reassessment, so 'poor response' unlocks a repeat. 'or' inside 'pain relief or functional improvement' is unclear on whether the 3 months applies to both.

and_or_ambiguity.quote: unresponsive to the following conservative treatment for ≥ 4 weeks: Pharmacotherapy such as nonsteroidal anti-inflammatory drugs or acetaminophen; or Activity modification ...; or Physical therapy or home exercise
and_or_ambiguity.why_ambiguous: Any one modality suffices (so ibuprofen for 4 weeks alone qualifies), yet the Definition of Conservative Therapy says 'an appropriate combination of medication ... in addition to physical therapy, spinal manipulation ...'. The Definition conflicts with the criterion if read as binding.

and_or_ambiguity.quote: There is evidence of structural and/or functional nerve root involvement by imaging or electrodiagnostic studies
and_or_ambiguity.why_ambiguous: 'and/or' and 'or' stacked; imaging not named (X-ray qualifies?), and no recency.

and_or_ambiguity.quote: The injection is performed under fluoroscopic or computed tomography guidance
and_or_ambiguity.why_ambiguous: A procedural fact known only at/after the procedure; for prior auth it is an intent.

extraction_hazards: Policy number on the PDF (2026T0616O) differs from the file/library number (N); effective date on page 1 (09/10/2026) differs from library metadata (2026-06-01).
Nested criteria use 'o' and square-bullet glyphs; 'and'/'or' float on their own lines between bullets.
Inequality symbols ≥ ≤ appear; the poor-response and good-response branches both contain 50%.
Header block 'See Benefit Considerations' etc. repeated; ICD table has 'All Regions' / 'Cervical/Thoracic' / 'Lumbar/Sacral' subheads in rows.
Policy History (p.13) contains a 'Medical Records Documentation Used for Reviews' list that reads like requirements but sits at the back.
interesting_structures: Whole criteria set fits on about one and a half pages.
'Subsequent ESIs' stated as a separate conditional (returned pain AND one of two prior-response branches) rather than a repeat criteria list.
Year is rolling from first approved injection, not calendar year.
Poor-response branch explicitly requires a reassessment of technique before another injection.

fit_to_tree.why: Short all-of with one any-of; clean. Strain: repeat rules need prior-injection history and a response measurement, and the 50% boundary appears in both branches.
